boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named University of Nevada, Reno destinations and activities with publicly documented free entry or free use.

cards.entity_name: John and Geraldine Lilley Museum of Art
cards.title: Browse the Lilley Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: University Foundation Arts Building
cards.notes: Meet up during posted gallery hours and take a slow lap through the exhibitions; admission is free, but check the visitor page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A free public art-museum visit on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The University states that admission to the Lilley Museum of Art is free.
cards.source_title: Lilley Museum of Art visitor information
cards.access_notes: Open during posted hours; the visitor page lists seasonal hours and any appointment option.

cards.title: Settle into the Knowledge Center
cards.subtitle: University Libraries
cards.notes: Bring a friend, choose a comfortable study spot, and browse the collections between classes; visitors may enter freely without borrowing materials.
cards.short_summary: A campus library hang with free entry and browsing.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says visitors, alumni, and community members are welcome and everyone is free to enter and browse collections.
cards.source_title: University Libraries visitor and alumni services
cards.access_notes: Free entry and browsing; observe library policies and check branch hours before visiting.

cards.title: Browse DeLaMare Engineering Library
cards.subtitle: University Libraries
cards.notes: Use the library as a quiet meet-up point, browse materials, or catch a public-facing library event when one is scheduled; entry is free.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries identifies DeLaMare as a welcoming library where everyone may enter freely and browse collections.
cards.source_title: University Libraries visitor and alumni services
cards.access_notes: Free entry and browsing; check library hours and posted space rules.

cards.title: Visit Savitt Medical Library
cards.subtitle: University Libraries
cards.notes: Plan a low-key reading or research stop with a friend and browse on site; visitors can enter without paying an admission fee.
cards.short_summary: A quiet medical-library visit with free entry.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Savitt Medical Library among its locations where everyone is free to enter and browse collections.
cards.source_title: University Libraries visitor and alumni services
cards.access_notes: Free entry and browsing; verify branch hours before arrival.

cards.title: Ride the PACKLine loop
cards.subtitle: PACKTransit campus stops
cards.notes: Hop on at a campus stop for a no-cost loop around campus, then choose a new study or outdoor stop to explore together.
cards.short_summary: A free campus-shuttle loop for getting around.
cards.evidence_claim: The University says PACKLine is free for all passengers boarding at campus stops and no ID is needed.
cards.source_title: University of Nevada, Reno working on campus
cards.access_notes: Runs 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Monday–Friday during fall and spring semesters; it does not operate during summer and winter breaks.

cards.title: Walk the Historic Quadrangle
cards.subtitle: University Arboretum area of interest
cards.notes: Take an unhurried walk through this named arboretum area, pause to look at the trees, and keep to open paths and posted campus guidance.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor arboretum walk on the historic core of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Arboretum lists Historic Quadrangle as an area of interest and says designated campus arboretum areas are open to the public for enjoyment and education.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-access area; visit during normal campus access and follow posted rules.

cards.title: Pause at Benson Gardens
cards.subtitle: University Arboretum area of interest
cards.notes: Use this named garden as a relaxed outdoor meeting point, then stroll onward through the arboretum’s public areas at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A named garden within the public campus arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists Benson Gardens as an Arboretum area of interest; the Arboretum says its designated campus areas are open to the public for enjoyment and educational pursuits.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-access area; visit during normal campus access and follow posted rules.

cards.title: See the Challenger Memorial
cards.subtitle: University Arboretum area of interest
cards.notes: Add the memorial to a walking loop with friends and spend a few minutes reading the site respectfully before continuing through campus.
cards.short_summary: A named memorial stop in the public arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists Challenger Memorial as an Arboretum area of interest; the Arboretum says designated campus areas are open to the public for enjoyment and educational pursuits.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-access area; visit during normal campus access and treat the memorial respectfully.

cards.title: Walk by Manzanita Lake
cards.subtitle: University Arboretum area of interest
cards.notes: Make this named lake a pause on an outdoor campus walk; bring conversation, not a plan to feed wildlife or leave anything behind.
cards.short_summary: A waterside stop in the public campus arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists Manzanita Lake as an Arboretum area of interest; the Arboretum says designated campus areas are open to the public for enjoyment and educational pursuits.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-access area; follow posted site guidance and campus rules.

cards.title: Stroll through Cherry Blossom Garden
cards.subtitle: University Arboretum area of interest
cards.notes: Choose this named garden for a brief fresh-air break, then continue the walk through other open arboretum areas without disturbing plantings.
cards.short_summary: A named garden stop within the public arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists Cherry Blossom Garden as an Arboretum area of interest; the Arboretum says designated campus areas are open to the public for enjoyment and educational pursuits.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-access area; visit during normal campus access and respect landscaping.
